column1: # Rows db.ub.* (line RG series D, item bp-SF2, 2026-11-27): a query batch whose setup fails with NCBI's engine error (`The average subject length is too short`: OLD_FSC=1 over the subjects of tests/db_search/q1c/avg_s.faa, of 2, 0 and 0 letters, or rpsblast's rps_mini with the alias n1000rps) after first batches that NCBI does not search (BATCH_SIZE=1 and tests/fasta/rps/allx_q649.faa: two X-only queries, then a valid one): NCBI writes the reports of those batches without the epilog, then exits 3 with the error, in every format (before bp-SF2 LOSAT refused there in the formats other than 0 to 4, 6, 7 and 10 and in rpsblast). Frozen with NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (the official build) on the developer machine.
